post.instagram_caption:
If your bank in India fails, only ₹5 lakh of your money is insured.

India Edition. DICGC insures deposits up to ₹5 lakh per depositor per bank, principal and interest together, a limit in place since Feb 4, 2020. As of March 31, 2026, that fully covered 97.4% of all accounts, but only 39.7% of the money: ₹109 lakh crore insured out of ₹275 lakh crore of assessable deposits, per DICGC's 2025-26 annual report.

Did you know the limit was per bank, not per account?

Source: DICGC Annual Report 2025-26, DICGC FAQs. Not financial advice.
